about.title: About UpRoof

We deliver complete roofing solutions including design, material selection, installation, painting and long-term maintenance. Our certified specialists pay attention to every detail, ensuring the highest standards of quality, safety and aesthetics. We offer a personal approach, clear communication and guaranteed results. construction.title: ROOF CONSTRUCTION
construction.description: We offer full-cycle roof construction and renovation with a <bold>10-year warranty</bold>. Roof structure restoration, insulation installation, roof covering installation, skylight installation, gutter system installation, and installation of other roof accessories.

roofStructure.title: ROOF STRUCTURE INSTALLATION
roofStructure.description: We install prefabricated roof trusses and timber roof structures. Services include rafter installation, wall plate installation, and roof frame assembly with precise geometry and reliable joints.

painting.title: ROOF PAINTING
painting.description: Metal roof painting for large and small roofs using three-level cleaning, rust treatment, and three-layer painting for excellent results and paint durability

maintenance.title: ROOF MAINTENANCE

metalProfile.title: METAL PROFILE INSTALLATION
metalProfile.description: Metal profile installation using fully hermetic tin double-fold solutions in all joints, connections with windows and chimneys. We are capable of performing complex metal profile work with non-standard solutions.

tiledRoof.title: TILE ROOF INSTALLATION
tiledRoof.description: Clay or concrete tile installation combined with our tin processing skills creates roofs that are completely hermetic and will serve for a lifetime. We ensure proper underlay ventilation and complete tile roofs with hermetic rolled tin connections at walls, windows, and other complex locations.

skylights.title: SKYLIGHT INSTALLATION
skylights.description: We offer Roto and Velux skylight installations in new projects and also adding them to existing roofs to gain additional light in the attic, while maintaining roof functionality.

gutterSystem.title: GUTTER SYSTEM INSTALLATION
gutterSystem.description: We install drainage systems in both easily and complexly accessible locations and heights. We ensure that gutters always operate with the water self-flow mechanism, making their functionality long-lasting. We also perform wind box restoration work when necessary for successful gutter installation.

chimneyConnection.title: CHIMNEY FLASHING INSTALLATION / REPAIR
chimneyConnection.description: High-precision chimney flashing installation and repair with watertight sheet-metal details. We stop leaks around penetrations, restore waterproofing, and secure long-term roof performance.

tileRoofRepair.title: TILE ROOF REPAIR
tileRoofRepair.description: Medium-to-high difficulty tile roof repair: replacement of damaged tiles, ridge and flashing restoration, leak elimination, and preventive maintenance for longer roof life.

snowRemoval.title: SNOW AND ICE REMOVAL FROM ROOF
snowRemoval.description: We engage in professional and safe snow removal from properties throughout Latvia. In snowy winters, falling ice on pedestrians is dangerous, so we help make roofs safer. We always care for controlled snow removal to the ground, traffic regulation, and also provide snow disposal and territory cleaning.

leafCleaning.title: ROOF CLEANING AND GUTTER CLEANING
leafCleaning.description: Accumulated leaves and branches block roof gutters and impede water drainage. But leaves and branches on the roof accumulate moisture, which accelerates roof damage and corrosion. Therefore, we always recommend proper roof maintenance before winter so it will work better and longer.

faq.title: QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS
faq.subtitle: Find answers to commonly asked questions about our roofing services.

q1.question: What services do we offer?
q1.answer: We specialize in high-quality roof construction, starting with the construction and renovation of roof structures, to the installation of roofing with all the necessary roof accessories and additional parts. For your convenience, we offer all the necessary roof solutions, including chimney renovation, skylight installation, gutter installation, construction of safety elements and others. We offer a 10-year warranty for the installation of our rolled profile roofs!

q2.question: Do we provide a warranty?
q2.answer: We provide a warranty for all our work, for example, we offer a 10-year warranty for rolled profile assembly work and an additional 50-year manufacturer's warranty for the materials used.

q3.question: How quickly can roof diagnostics be performed?
q3.answer: We use advanced diagnostic equipment to assess roof conditions efficiently. For most projects, we can complete a thorough inspection and provide a detailed assessment within 1-2 business days after initial contact.

q4.question: What types of roofs do we work with?
q4.answer: We work with pitched roof construction and renovation and the most common materials we use are rolled metal roofs, metal sheet roofs and tiled roofs, but we can also install your special material. Our team consists of several teams, each of which specializes in a specific type of roof and regularly updates its knowledge to provide the best solutions for each type of roof.

q5.question: Can roof repairs be carried out in winter?
q5.answer: Yes, we can perform most roof repairs year-round. While some materials work best in warmer weather, we have specialized techniques and materials that allow us to safely complete emergency repairs even in cold conditions.

q6.question: Are metal roofs noisy?
q6.answer: Metal roofs are louder compared to other roofing materials, but this is more myth than reality. Metal roofs can be made quiet by incorporating sound-dampening layers during construction. If the roof is on an attic floor, insulation and ventilation create air and insulation barriers that block sound. If the roof has no insulation, the cold attic and insulated attic floor provide sufficient distance. Most people living under metal roofs confirm that sound is not bothersome in daily life, and sometimes even find the rain sound pleasant and calming.
